in_marathi.name: Anumeha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anumeha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘anu’ meaning ‘towards’ and ‘meha’ meaning ‘mind’ or ‘desire’. Anumeha represents a deep longing or intense desire towards something.
